description: Records the buyer's rating of a shipped order, 1–5 stars: quality and as_described (goods match the photos and specs) are required, packaging and service optional. Only send ratings the buyer actually gave you; never guess them. Ratings feed Moqway's supplier rating and are not shown to the supplier. Calling again replaces the rating (allowed for 90 days after shipping).
name: rate_order
title: Rate an order
